description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location on Main Street in Osoyoos, sitting at the southern tip of the Okanagan wine country and a natural stop on cycling routes along Highway 3. The shop offers the full Starbucks espresso and seasonal beverage menu with outdoor seating, making it a convenient rest point for riders crossing the Similkameen corridor. As a recognized chain, it provides predictable food and drink options in a town that serves as a gateway to several long-distance touring routes.
